relations.rationale: Rule 6.2: the sentence is phrased as the exemption itself and names only the thing exempted from (the fiscal impact statement), so that noun phrase is the implied target. The exempting wording 'is not required' is the introducer; the only remaining clause content, the statutory frame 'under RCW 28A.305.135', is the PART since it is the scope of the non-requirement and is not an interrupting citation. Agency procedural exemption, so not critical.

Rule 6.2, same pattern as R1: the sentence states the exemption and names the thing exempted from (a cost-benefit analysis), which is the implied target. 'is not required' introduces; 'under RCW 34.05.328' is the PART as the statutory frame of the non-requirement. An analysis the agency is excused from preparing, so not critical.

introducer.text: is not mandated to comply with

clause.text: Pursuant to RCW  34.05.328 (5)(a)(i), the college is not mandated to comply with

excluded.note: statutory authority for the exemption, not the exempted population

relations.rationale: Rule 6.2: the sentence is phrased as the exemption; the governed assertion (the college must comply with RCW 34.05.328) is stated nowhere positively, so the named thing exempted from, 'RCW 34.05.328', is the implied target. 'is not mandated to comply with' is the exempting introducer and 'the college' is the exempted population. The leading 'Pursuant to RCW 34.05.328 (5)(a)(i)' is the cross-reference giving the authority and is excluded as citation. Internal agency procedural exemption, so not critical.

clause.text: This rule proposal, or portions of the proposal, is exempt from

relations.rationale: Rule 6.2: the sentence is phrased as the exemption and names the thing exempted from (requirements of the Regulatory Fairness Act), which is the implied target; 'is exempt from' introduces. The exempted population is coordinated by an explicit 'or', so it is an OR node over 'This rule proposal' and 'portions of the proposal' (rule 4). The trailing 'because the proposal: Is exempt under RCW 19.85.025(3)... Is exempt under RCW 19.85.025(4)' states the statutory grounds for the same exemption, not conditions on it, and is left out of the clause. Agency procedural exemption (small-business impact analysis), so not critical.

clause.text: only to internal governmental operations that are not subject to violation by a nongovernment party

quotes.text: to internal governmental operations that are
subject to violation by a nongovernment party

relations.rationale: Exclusive wording 'only' restricts what the rules relate to, so RESTRICT with the whole restricted complement as the PART (rule 7), including the preposition 'to' that belongs to the restricted phrase. 'not' negates only this single component's own relative-clause predicate ('are not subject to violation'), so it is a PART marker with the quotes split around it (rule 4). This is a reason given for a procedural exemption, so not critical.

out_of_scope_notes: Comment window ('beginning October 7, 2026, at 8:00 a.m., by November 17, 2026, at 8:00 a.m.'), the hearing date/time and the disability-assistance deadline are plain temporal bounds with no conditional wording; no class in 4.1 covers them, so no relation is recorded.

'Is exempt under RCW 19.85.025(3)' and 'Is exempt under RCW 19.85.025(4)' (list items broken across paragraphs after 'because the proposal:') and 'Is fully exempt.' restate the Regulatory Fairness Act exemption (R4) with its statutory grounds and scope; they add no condition and are not recorded as separate relations.

'the college does not voluntarily make that section applicable to the adoption of this rule pursuant to subsection (5)(a)(ii), and to date the joint administrative rules committee has not made that section applicable' are factual statements of why RCW 34.05.328 does not apply (background to R3), not condition clauses; not recorded.

WAC 132M-110-060(2): 'Any person wishing to request access to public records ..., or seeking assistance in making such a request' is a participial qualifier of the subject (rule 7), not a condition; the 'or' inside it therefore has no node.
WAC 132M-110-060(3): 'but another college staff member may process requests' is a contrasting permission, not an exception carved out of 'will oversee compliance'; not recorded.
Extraction retains Washington Register strike/insert markup as double parentheses, e.g. '((Vice President of Administration))Public Records Officer' and '(((2)))(3)'; the old text is not annotated.
Statute citations contain doubled spaces ('RCW  34.05.328'), reproduced exactly in quotes.
